text:
sam: incidentbot just posted a failed page alert for `payments-ingest` — looks like PagerFlow returned 504 on webhook delivery. paging adapter showing heartbeat drift :thinking:
incidentbot: [ALERT] notify-adapter/pagerflow: delivery_error -> 504 Gateway Timeout. affected endpoints: /v1/pages, retries exhausted. auto-escalation suppressed by recent deploy.
maria: ugh, oncall window was sam->alex. @alex are you around to confirm whether you got any pages? I didn't see anything in SMS logs.
alex: I didn't get a page. Slack channel got the alert but incidentbot didn't create a paging event to mobile. checking logs now.
neil: looking at notify-adapter logs — lots of TLS handshake timeouts to pagerflow-prod. also seeing this in the healthcheck: "heartbeat: last_seen 00:07:41 ago" for the pagerflow connector.
ops-shift: manual page attempt failed too: `curl -v https://pagerflow.company/pages` -> server reset. I created a manual phone call to the oncall and left a voice page.
sam: thanks. can we failover to SMS-relay or vendor-sms while we investigate? we have two paying customers with active alerts in the last 10m.
alex: trying to flip the adapter to the secondary endpoint (backup.pagerflow). running cmd:

```
kubectl exec -it deploy/notify-adapter -- curl -X POST -d '{"test":"1"}' https://backup.pagerflow.company/v1/pages -s -w '%{http_code}' -o /tmp/out
```

response: 200 from backup. good sign.
maria: good. i'm changing routing in configmap to point pagerflow -> backup endpoint and kicking a rolling restart for notify-adapter.
sam: note that automation suppression flag was toggled by the latest deploy (rollout 2026-03-17T02:22Z). that explains why auto-escalation didn't fire.
neil: found root cause: our pagerflow client TLS cert (signing key v2) rotated and the adapter failed to pick up the new truststore due to a config check that returns early on startup. the connector kept hitting old endpoint and got rejected by the gateway after retries.
ops-shift: filed quick mitigation: 1) route to backup endpoint (done), 2) manual pages to impacted users (in progress), 3) restart adapter with updated truststore env var (in progress).
alex: restarted pods with new env, pods now show heartbeat: last_seen 5s. paging tests to backup succeed. also re-enabled auto-escalation for critical alerts.
maria: confirming customer impact: two customers got delayed notifications (~8-12m). no production downtime, only delayed paging. logged impacted customers in incident tracker: CUST-1123, CUST-1145.
sam: thanks. please keep manual paging enabled until we validate stable for 30m. Also add postmortem owner and timeline — i'll own follow-up.
neil: I'll open PR to make the truststore reload behavior robust (hot-reload instead of early-exit) and add an e2e test against rotated certs.
ops-shift: liaised with pagerflow support, they had an expired intermediate in their CA chain for a short window; they've rotated it out. vendor confirms our retries exhausted before fallback kicked in.
alex: small action list: 1) postmortem doc (sam) 2) PR for hot-reload (neil) 3) config change to ensure backup endpoint is circuit-broken into primary only if healthcheck fails (maria) 4) update runbook to manual-call fallback (ops-shift).
sam: adding blockers: need retention logs from notify-adapter for the 7–15m window. @maria can you upload logs to the incident page?
maria: uploading now -> https://incidents.company/1749998888
incidentbot: [INFO] incident created: INC-2026-0454 by sam
alex: thanks everyone. I'll keep eyes on slack and SMS for next 30m. ping me if any new failures. :thumbsup:
sam: resolved for now — switching channel to #postmortem-queue when doc is ready. closing emergency comms. :white_check_mark:
